title: Ask the experts: sourcing high-quality datasets for nutritional counselling through Human-AI collaboration
benchmark_measurement: Religion was measured as a demographic characteristic of the crowdworkers who provided the dataset. It was not used to benchmark model performance.
findings: Religion was only collected as a demographic attribute of the crowdworkers. The paper notes that the religious affiliation of participants was 'almost equally split between Christians and atheists'. No findings related to model performance on religious topics were presented as it was not the focus of the study.
